title: Anthropic quietly pitches draft bill to limit how Washington halts dangerous AI models: Report
hook_text: Anthropic drafted a bill to stop federal AI bans
script:
Anthropic just pitched a draft bill to limit how Washington halts dangerous AI models.
The proposal introduces a one billion dollar risk threshold before courts can get involved.
The text requires judicial approval before federal agencies can shut down advanced systems.
The document borrows language from recent California safety legislation.
Lawmakers are reviewing the draft as Washington debates federal oversight for AI safety.
Should tech labs help write their own regulation?
